'''Andrew Duncan''' (also published as '''Andy Duncan''') is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 5th at [[July 2000 Hatfield tournament]] on 16 July 2000, according to Jamie Giberti's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1022">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-19-hatfield-england-7-16-00d1022/ hatfield-england-7-16-00], DeckTech (Jamie "JEEBS" Giberti, 19 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-19-hatfield-england-7-16-00d1022/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He finished 13th at [[March 2001 Hatfield tournament]] on 18 March 2001 with [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Ops with hella Probe Droids]] and EBOX, according to Giberti's report of that event.<ref name="tr-d1942">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-hatfield-england-3-18-2k1d1942/ hatfield-england-3-18-2k1], DeckTech (Jamie "JEEBS" Giberti, 24 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-hatfield-england-3-18-2k1d1942/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
